description: Policy for mutation testing of validators. Mutations introduce defects to verify the validator can still reject bad output.

mutation_definitions.description: Invert a boolean condition in the validator (e.g., == becomes !=)
Remove one check from the validator entirely
Change a numeric threshold to an incorrect value
Swap the expected output with a different value
Replace the validation body with a pass-all stub
Replace the return value with always PASS

rule: If a mutated validator still passes all fixtures, the original validator may be returning always-pass or ignoring its input. This indicates the validator is NOT trustworthy and must not be certified above V0.
